notes.title: Bug Fixes / Updates / Basic Combat
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where hidden rooms and dead ends would only spawn towards the outer edges of the dungeon
 Fixed an issue that did not display dungeon run stats at the end of a dungeon run

  Fixed an issue where some battles would launch twice
  Fixed an save issue where inventory gold was not being saved properly when purchasing items from vendors
  Fixed memory leak during dungeon build, which was causing large drops in frame rate.


Game Updates
 Basic Combat set up with a few unique minion fights, mini boss fights, 1 boss room, and 1 hidden mega boss.  Units are still being balanced.   Combinations not set up just yet (though there are a few currently in the game as placeholders).
 Added Loading Screen to preload a portion of the scene, to allow for faster dungeon building and less memory usage.  
  Added a number of traps and interactable items in the dungeon.  
  Characters, Enemies, and Rooms can now be unlocked, which will appear in future dungeon builds.
  Interacting with dungeon NPCs may now have different results depending on which heroes are in your party.
  Thief & Dark Mage characters can now be discovered and unlocked.

notes.title: Small Update / Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42344856/cb13b8d5b7d10a0b8121654a53a9721a69d1ba07.gif

Game Updates

 2 party characters have been added and can now be found & unlocked in the dungeon.  Rogue (Jail Room) & Void Mage (Templar Library).
 A few additional room interactions added.
 Unlockable enemies (Templar Knights) added after Void Mage Unlock
 Goblin Map Vendor once unlocked (Lamp Room) now sells map fragments 1 and 2 (will not sell part 3 revealing secrets), for 50 gold and 250 gold.  
 Players can now bank gold at campfire.  Banked gold is available at start of next run, and can still be used in dungeon when banked.
 Healer NPC added to Sanctuary - Will Heal Party & Remove any active curses.
 Old Knight NPC added to Sanctuary - Provides game tips.
 Blacksmith (and Dungeon NPC's leveling STR & DEF) now active.  Upgrading is free for testing.  Blacksmith in Sanctuary can be used over and over, but dungeon blacksmiths should be single interactions.  


UI Updates

 Map Updates include clearer indicators for already visited rooms
 Confirmation UI added.
 BlackSmith UI added - w/ Party Viewer for live model of selected character

notes.title: Hotfixes & UI/Map Enhancements
notes.content:
BUG FIXES:

 Portals:  Fixed an issue where portals would not open when falling down trap doors.
 Portals:  Fixed an issue where portals would not include all hidden rooms.
 Map: Fixed curving on map


MAPS:

 Added Keyboard & Joystick instruction
 Added ability to move up, down, left, and right from current player position when viewing map.
 Added map enhancements, including easier recognition of dead ends, and highlighting rooms already visited by player.


LOWER-UI:

 Moved Compass to lower UI in bottom right of screen.
 Lower left UI added to act as visual cue for interaction of objects, portals, enemies, and more.
 Message box added for in game notifications.


Inventory & Inventory UI:

 Inventory now tracks items picked up.
 Inventory UI available to view current items.  UI has 3 sections - Dungeons, Battle, and Key Items.
 Notification added when item added to inventory, including item description.


Cut Scene Skipping

 Added UI - visual indicator for cut scene skips (placeholder UI).


CONTENT

 When activated, Cursed Statues may now stalk player around the dungeon.  
 Map Vendor added to Sanctuary (not active).
 A few additional cutscenes added.

notes.title: Complete Game Rebuild - Controller Support - Quality of Life Fix
notes.content:
THANK YOU FRIENDS AND TESTERS!

A few quality of life fixes for the game:

GAME STATE

Currently, The dungeon environment should build and fill.  You should be able to explore and interact with a few chests & items.   However Combat does not trigger and the boss room is currently locked, exploration only.  

FIXED:
1. Removed pause feature during cutscenes when bringing up UI that was causing issues.  Holding Space (or on Controllers the A Button), will now skip (most) scenes.  
2. Fixed error with UI becoming unfocused and unclickable.  When UI is active, clicking in-game anywhere other than menu buttons will default select the top menu button.
3. Fixed error where switches in Small Lamp Room would lock, but not unlock.  Also increased speed of switch animation 2x.  
4. Portals now do not assign until active, to prevent repeat jumps into empty rooms.  (May need additional testing, but I think it's fixed).  

NEW:
1. Introduced a few puzzles, keep an eye out for switches in some rooms.

2. Dungeon now builds behind starting room.  Character Select (which is currently automatic) and active vendors will be available (which they currently aren't) while dungeon builds and fills in the background. Players will be able to buy supplies while builder finishes larger dungeons.  Current build time is very short, but anticipating longer loading when building more massive dungeons. (Size defaulted to "normal" currently).  

3. MAP Enhancements - Opening a chest will now add a map fragment to your hidden inventory:

fragment x1 - map shows dungeon layout, but not secret areas, and does not show room icons.
fragment x2 - map shows layout and all icons, but not secret areas.
fragment x3 - map shows layout, all icons, and secrets.  

New icon to indicate a dead-end, so that previously explored dead ends and unexplored hallways look different on map.

4. CONTROLLER COMPATABILITY
- Controller support in typical X-box layout is now available.  

Active buttons:
- Start - Menu
- Joysticks - Move / Strafe / Turn
- A Button - Interact
- Y Button - Toggle Map
- (X / B will be assigned once full UI is available)
NOTE - Still working through Steam compatibility checklist.  Not all features available yet.  (For example, game does not pause when controller disconnects at this time).
